messages.subject: R has been accepted!
parts:
I'm happy to report that Google has annouced that R has been officially accepted as a mentoring organization for GSOC2017! https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/organizations/4947241283354624/

Thanks to all who have contributed to our wiki projects list https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects

Students, now it is time to start working on project applications. Before submitting an application, make sure to complete some project tests, and get in touch with mentors via email.
